body.title: Ground both dimension verdicts in source evidence
body.summary: Opt adherence and functional coverage into source inspection; revise single/divided guidance, require confidence and normalize unverified or legacy confidence gaps LOW. Preserve source-proven omissions, scope/FR filters and no-contract behavior. Extend fixtures to read-only sessions.
acceptanceChecks: Both dimensions check relevant source/helpers before breach; summaries and absent notes never prove missing implementation.
HIGH/MED observations and legacy missing confidence normalize to LOW observation; explicit source-proven full or partial breaches retain appropriate severity and real code location.

Tests for both dimensions and both paths distinguish helper-implemented behavior absent from summaries, genuinely omitted behavior, missing notes, unreadable source, out-of-scope locations and invalid FR ids.

tests.name: Both dimension prompts/schema/results distinguish proven breach, LOW observation and legacy missing confidence while preserving filters.
Both dimensions in single/divided pipeline: helper implementation missing from summaries passes, genuine omission remains HIGH, missing notes/unreadable source remain LOW.
